versions.content: Ethernet Switch Filtering and Policing Description: The System Template shall support Ethernet Switch Filtering and Policing. Rationale: These mechanisms can be used to avoid bursts, restrict babbling idiots and to prevent denial of service attacks. Use Case: Ensure bandwith for critical applications. Dependencies: – Supporting Material: IEEE Std 802.1Q-2018, section Qci 8.6
